comments.body:
NB : Tried to add the copilot-instructions.md file at the specified location and it still doesn't work.
Also, I am not able to delete chats from history after restarting vscode (but maybe it's normal and not linked, idk)
Ditto - My copilot is getting `This tool must be called from within an editing session` issues when trying to save changes to files
Telling him "You do not edit the files, you have to use relative paths for insert_edit_into_file" worked for me.
